items.title: Advantages and Disadvantages of Network Topologies (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Advantages and Disadvantages of Network Topologies' (PDF 11-12): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Mukhtalif topologies ke mukhtalif fawaid (benefits) hain. Kuch install karne (lagane) mein aasan aur sasti hain (jaise Table 1.1 mein). Kuch zyada reliability (bharosa) aur performance deti hain. Kuch topologies ko expand karna (barhana) aasan hai. Kuch ko manage karna mushkil aur mehnga hai. Sahi topology chunna network ki zarooraton par depend karta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Kuch topologies saada aur sasti hain. Kuch qabil-e-bharosa magar mehngi hain. Kuch barhane mein aasan hain. Kuch sambhalne mein mushkil hain. Kaun si chunein, yeh zaroorat par depend karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek chhoti dukaan ke 4 computers ke liye kam kharche wali topology chahiye, aur ek bank ke data center ke liye aisi jo kabhi na ruke. Har ek ke liye kaun si topology?
blocks.explanation: Dukaan: bus ya star (sasti aur lagana aasan; star sambhalne mein behtar). Bank data center: mesh (kai raaste, bohat reliable), chahe mehngi ho.

items: Bus: sasti magar main cable par sab kuch. Star: aasan magar central device par sab kuch.
Ring: tarteeb wala bahao magar ek device par sab kuch. Mesh: sab se reliable magar mehngi. Tree: barhana aasan magar backbone par sab kuch.
